summary: Configured persistent resilient static routing. The direct node2↔node3 transit is preferred, VyOS node1 provides the fallback, failover completed in 1.210 seconds, and direct-path preference returned in 0.418 seconds. Source addresses were preserved and management routing remained isolated. All nodes passed serial restart persistence checks.
